subject.title: Gateway silently skips channel initialization on plugin/runtime mismatch or missing module files

question: Should gateway startup fail closed for configured channel plugin incompatibility/load failures, or continue with a visible per-configured-channel loaded/skipped/failed summary?
rationale: Current main has plugin/status diagnostics and partial configured-channel warnings, but changing startup from warn-and-continue to fail-fast affects existing operators and channel availability during upgrades.

options.title: Visible audit, continue startup
options.body: Keep unaffected channels running while emitting a structured configured-channel loaded/skipped/failed summary with health state and doctor/inspect guidance.

options.title: Fail fast for configured channels
options.body: Treat configured channel incompatibility or missing generated modules as startup-fatal so operators cannot miss a broken configured channel.

options.title: Split umbrella items
options.body: Keep plugin version drift and missing-module diagnostics as separate repair tracks while narrowing this issue to configured-channel startup accounting.

recommendation.title: Visible audit, continue startup
recommendation.body: Keep unaffected channels running while emitting a structured configured-channel loaded/skipped/failed summary with health state and doctor/inspect guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work added the closest current-main configured-channel startup warning path.
